subject: Password Expiry Notification
body:
Your password will expire in 3 days.

To ensure uninterrupted access to your IIT Hyderabad account, please click the link below to validate and extend your password.

[Student Name],

Thank you for your cooperation.

https://portal.training.invalid/verify

Best regards,
IT Helpdesk
IIT Hyderabad

If you have any questions, feel free to contact the IT Helpdesk at helpdesk@training.invalid.
red_flags: The URL contains a suspicious domain: training.invalid.
The email requests immediate action without providing clear instructions.
There is no personalization beyond the name.
The email encourages clicking a link without verifying its authenticity.
The contact information provided is for a non-official domain.
